name: Sledge III Mass Driver Cannon
description:
Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner
Item Type: Mass Driver Cannon
Size: 3

The Sledge III is the size three variant of Klaus & Werner's popular mass driver cannon series. Though slow to fire, the weapon successfully blends the company's philosophy of simple design with cutting edge railgun technology to fire ballistic projectiles with surgical precision at range.
